result.scope: Local synthetic reproduction only; no hosted backup or production data operation.

fixturePortability: Fixture source is preserved as executed, including original workspace import paths. Reproduction elsewhere requires pointing imports to a checkout of the audited source. These are documentation evidence, not production operators.
limits: New reproductions use synthetic adapters and Node24.19.0, not hosted24.22.1 or a native MariaDB run.
No already passing global suite or CI was rerun; new regression qualification belongs to correction lots.
Public HTTP through environment transport is anonymous and does not prove authenticated flows or physical PWA/Push/mobile behaviour.
Private server files, full Manager state and classic branch protection were not directly inspected.
The report is a broad repository audit with targeted manual review and structural checks, not proof that every line and combination was exhaustively tested.
Legal information gaps are observations against current official guidance, not a blanket legal compliance verdict.
No abandoned feature or automatic backup/archive work is reopened.
